_comment: Seed manifest for the linkding target (plan-003 U2, R6). Seeding is API-driven: target_env.py POSTs each entry to /api/bookmarks/ with a headlessly-minted ApiToken. All cached target-side evidence and a11y fingerprints are defined against THIS post-seed state — changing it is a deliberate, recorded apparatus migration, not an edit. URLs are never fetched (background tasks disabled), so they only need to be unique and stable.
